title: Request for Apple Watch Support
body:
Dear Development Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic support for the development of an Apple Watch-compatible version of this app. As a dedicated user, I believe extending compatibility to the Apple Watch would significantly enhance the user experience by providing greater convenience and accessibility.

Please consider adding this feature in future updates. Your attention to this request would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you for your hard work and dedication.
